class.name: GodotDoctorEditorRunner
class.brief_description: A [GodotDoctorRunner] that validates the currently open scene and inspected resource in the Godot editor. Triggered automatically on save (if configured) or manually.

method.name: _run
method.description: Runs validation for the currently open scene root and the resource open in the inspector.

method.name: _run_for_edited_scene_root
method.description: Validates the scene root currently open in the editor. Emits scene collection signals around the validation run.

method.name: _run_for_edited_resource
method.description: Validates the resource currently open in the inspector, if it has a script. Emits resource collection signals around the validation run.

signal.name: started_run_for_edited_scene_root
signal.description: Emitted when a validation run starts for [param scene_root] in the editor.

signal.name: finished_run_for_edited_scene_root
signal.description: Emitted when a validation run finishes for [param scene_root] in the editor.

signal.name: started_run_for_edited_resource
signal.description: Emitted when a validation run starts for the resource open in the inspector.

signal.name: finished_run_for_edited_resource
signal.description: Emitted when a validation run finishes for the resource open in the inspector.
